scope: shared-supply dispatch simulation; no live traffic or customer assignment

assignment.seed_derivation: SHA256(design_id|seed|zone_id|block_index), first 16 hex digits masked to 63 bits
assignment.balance_rule: equal candidate/comparator blocks per zone; preserve common demand and courier streams

washout.rule: exclude the first five ticks after each arm switch from primary summaries; retain them for carryover diagnostics

interference_risks.mechanism: courier availability is shared by all orders in a zone and period
interference_risks.spillover: assignment in one order changes supply for later orders
interference_risks.mitigation: keep the zone and common courier stream fixed within paired blocks
interference_risks.diagnostic: record supply trajectory digest and assignment queue by block

interference_risks.mechanism: courier movement crosses zone boundaries during a block
interference_risks.spillover: an arm can alter neighboring-zone availability
interference_risks.mitigation: retain all zones in the same block and stratify summaries by origin/destination zone
interference_risks.diagnostic: count cross-zone transitions and report them before any comparison

interference_risks.mechanism: orders and courier state persist across an arm switch
interference_risks.spillover: the next arm inherits unfinished work from the previous arm
interference_risks.mitigation: warmup plus explicit washout; no switch-boundary ticks enter the primary window
interference_risks.diagnostic: report unfinished-order and courier-state digests at every boundary

metrics.not_estimable_without_outcomes: No effect, causal, or generalization statement is estimable from this design alone.
